reports.title: Fortune Brands Announces Third Quarter Results,

guidance.heading: 2026 Full-Year Guidance
section: “Looking ahead, we see a softer environment for single-family new construction and expect this part of the market to be down mid to high single digits, with R&R down low single digits for the year. Customers are signaling greater caution and we are taking a more conservative approach to channel inventory given the uncertain macroeconomic environment. We have also made important decisions on dilutive parts of our portfolio, which we expect will help improve future profitability. Those businesses will continue to have an impact on our results for the fourth quarter and the first half of next year. With these factors in mind, we are prudently updating our guidance for net sales and EPS before charges / gains. Fourth quarter and full year net sales are expected to be in the range of $925 million to $995 million and $4,205 million to $4,275 million, respectively. Fourth quarter and full year EPS before charges / gains is expected to be in the range of $0.19 to $0.29 and $3.20 to $3.30, respectively. We also expect full year operating cash flow and free cash flow to be in the range of $480 million to $500 million and $380 million to $410 million, respectively," said Fortune Brands Chief Financial Officer Pete Clifford. "While these actions will weigh on our near-term results, they position us to enter 2027 on stronger footing."
